summary.text: Ernie Marcelain is the Democratic candidate for Illinois State Senate District 38 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Sue Rezin. A former firefighter and EMT, he works as a manager.

paragraphs.text: Marcelain was born in Lake Forest, Illinois, and earned a high school diploma from Sandwich High School and an associate degree from Waubonsee Community College.
His career experience includes working as a manager, firefighter, and EMT with paramedic training.
He won the Democratic primary on March 17, 2026, with 13,574 votes in an uncontested race.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Marcelain described himself as a former union member and firefighter/EMT, a husband of 24 years and the father of a 22-year-old daughter.

He listed three campaign messages: making life more affordable for working Americans, protecting and expanding health care and hospitals, and boosting small businesses while creating good-paying jobs.
